**Self-review.** Round 1's account was chosen after the exact computation had refuted the reading in its exact form, and was anchored on CG2's two published outcomes; its sharpest case failed and is reported as failed. Round 2 was designed after round 1's verdicts from its greedy tables, so its account is post hoc in origin; its predictions for six new conditions were frozen before any of their runs, and the sharp one (Z3) held while the threshold (Z1) failed. Code-path tests before each freeze used untrained learners and wrote nowhere kept. The literature check found every mechanism known; what is recorded is the boundary of CG2's law, not a new learning result.
